homeTitle: A personal tutor that knows your child.

landing.grow.title: How a star grows
landing.grow.lead: Every topic is a star in the child's own sky. It fills only with real evidence, and it sprouts when the learning is still there two weeks later.
landing.grow.step1Body: A topic the child has not tried yet. It shows as a dashed outline.
landing.grow.step2Body: The first questions are in. The star starts to fill from the bottom.
landing.grow.step3Body: More right than wrong, across different kinds of question.
landing.grow.step4Body: Nine of the last ten right. The star is full.
landing.grow.step5Body: Still right on a check two weeks later. The star sprouts.
landing.parents.title: A weekly report with evidence, not grades
landing.parents.lead: Every Sunday, parents get a short report in the app and a summary on WhatsApp. It says what their child practised, what they mastered and why we think so, and one thing to practise next.
landing.parents.bullet1: You create the account and give permission. Your child never needs an email or phone number.
landing.parents.bullet2: Children sign in with a picture key, never a password.
landing.parents.bullet3: Works on a low-cost Android phone the family already has.

landing.report.statBody: Tolu practised on 5 days and answered 46 questions.
landing.report.celebrateBody: Tolu has mastered Fractions: 9 of the last 10 right, including a check two weeks later.
landing.report.nextBody: Word problems with money. Tolu gets the sums right but sometimes picks the wrong number to start with. Two short sets this week would help.

landing.goal.name: Common Entrance preparation
landing.goal.disclaimer: Pace shows syllabus coverage over time. It is not a predicted score.
landing.goal.title: Set a goal, then learn at your child's pace
landing.goal.body1: You and your child choose a goal, like Common Entrance in May, and how many sets a week fit your family. There are no class deadlines. Stellara orders the topics and shows whether the pace you picked covers them all in time.
landing.goal.body2: Missed a day? A resting cloud keeps the days in a row safe. You can change the pace at any time.
landing.ce.title: Coverage you can check, topic by topic
landing.ce.lead: Coverage is the share of syllabus topics a pupil has mastered. It tells you what has been learned, and what has not been reached yet. It is not a predicted score.
landing.ce.footnote: Subject list to confirm against the current NCEE syllabus. Figures are illustrative.
landing.start.title: How to start
landing.start.step1Body: Use your Google account in one tap, or get a sign-in link by email. You must be over 18 years old to create an account and give permission for your child.
landing.start.step2Body: Read what we collect and why, in plain words, and agree for your child. You can withdraw at any time.
landing.start.step3Title: Add your child and a goal
landing.start.step3Body: Add their name and class, choose a goal such as Common Entrance, and pick how many sets a week.
landing.start.step4Title: Your child picks a picture key
landing.start.step4Body: Four pictures instead of a password. Then they start their first set at their own pace.
landing.privacy.title: Privacy, in plain words
landing.privacy.lead: We follow the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA). A parent or guardian gives permission before a child uses Stellara.
landing.privacy.item1: A parent or guardian over 18 years old must sign in and give consent before their child can start.
landing.privacy.item2: Children sign in with a picture key. We never ask a child for a password, email or phone number.
landing.privacy.item3: We use learning data only to teach your child and to report to you. We do not sell it or use it for adverts.
landing.privacy.item4: Parents can download or delete their child’s data at any time from the app.
landing.privacy.item5: Withdrawing consent stops all data collection the same day.
landing.cta.title: Start with one child
landing.cta.body: Sign in with Google or your email (18+), give permission, and set your child’s first goal. It takes about five minutes.
